video_title: Kawhi Showed Up to His "No-Show" Job. We Followed the Money.

quotes.speaker: Sam Koppelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Koppelman suggests the Clippers salary cap scandal could involve securities fraud
quotes.excerpt: This might not just be an NBA problem, this might be securities fraud.
quotes.quote: This might not just be an NBA problem, this might be securities fraud.

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: Amin Elhassan explains the hierarchy of American Airlines flight status
quotes.excerpt: On American, it goes silver, gold, platinum, platinum pro, executive platinum.
quotes.quote: On American, it goes silver, gold, platinum, platinum pro, executive platinum. That's the highest that you can achieve with flying. But then there's a level above executive platinum called concierge key. It's invite only.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson admits to losing his American Airlines concierge key status
quotes.excerpt: I gave up my concierge key. I lost it because it just was a temporary thing.
quotes.quote: I gave up my concierge key. I lost it because it just was a temporary thing. But I have enough miles that I'm good.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson jokes about the 'Do Not Look' label in his folder
quotes.excerpt: Do not look, David is the first sheet in David's folder.
quotes.quote: Do not look, David is the first sheet in David's folder.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson discusses the Clippers' interim governor situation
quotes.excerpt: The alternate governors were Dennis Wong and Gillian Zucker, and Gillian Zucker is suspended and gone.
quotes.quote: The alternate governors were Dennis Wong and Gillian Zucker, and Gillian Zucker is suspended and gone, so it can't be her. Dennis Wong, because of reporting that you've done, seems to be not eligible to be the governor quite clearly because he would have been the natural choice to do it in Steve's absence.

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: Amin Elhassan criticizes the Clippers' 'culture of compliance' messaging
quotes.excerpt: I've never heard in any sort of kind of inspirational video, whatever, our main bullet point is to build a culture of compliance.
quotes.quote: I've never heard in any sort of kind of inspirational video, whatever, our main bullet point is to build a culture of compliance. Holy.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson identifies the Clippers' new interim governor
quotes.excerpt: They went with someone who represented the Clippers in a lawsuit against Donald Sterling actually.
quotes.quote: They went with someone who represented the Clippers in a lawsuit against Donald Sterling actually, and he is a well-known lawyer out there in LA.

quotes.speaker: Sam Koppelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Koppelman explains how Boingo Wireless was taken private
quotes.excerpt: A private equity firm that would become known as Digital Bridge.
quotes.quote: A private equity firm that would become known as Digital Bridge.

quotes.speaker: Sam Koppelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Koppelman discusses the statute of limitations for securities fraud
quotes.excerpt: The statute of limitations is generally for this kind of securities fraud, five years.
quotes.quote: The statute of limitations is generally for this kind of securities fraud, five years. It could be six years if it's conspiracy.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson explains why related party transaction disclosures are mandatory
quotes.excerpt: The reason why disclosure matters, it's the way to level the playing field with ordinary everyday investors.
quotes.quote: The reason why disclosure matters, it's the way to level the playing field with ordinary everyday investors.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the ethics of corporate sponsorship deals
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't do business in our stadium with a company if they did not buy season tickets.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't do business in our stadium with a company if they did not buy season tickets or they did not do some sort of corporate sponsorship deal. That is normal.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the standard practice of player meet-and-greets
quotes.excerpt: A player getting 600 plus grand to go make an appearance, I'm not going to tell you that doesn't happen.
quotes.quote: A player getting 600 plus grand to go make an appearance, I'm not going to tell you that doesn't happen because I've seen it happen, I've made it happen.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson notes Kawhi Leonard's careful wording in his statement
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard was very careful not in any way to acknowledge his knowledge of any salary cap circumvention.
quotes.quote: Kawhi Leonard was very careful not in any way to acknowledge his knowledge of any salary cap circumvention of any issues with any endorsement deals of any kind.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson explains the SEC's investigative process
quotes.excerpt: When you're investigating somebody and you're part of the SEC, the first thing you're doing is figuring out.
quotes.quote: When you're investigating somebody and you're part of the SEC, the first thing you're doing is figuring out what's the statute of limitations for the crime that we think was committed and when does that clock start ticking.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the importance of finding an event to delay the SEC clock
quotes.excerpt: They are always looking for an event that can delay the start of the clock.
quotes.quote: They are always looking for an event that can delay the start of the clock, so you don't need a four-bounce three-pointer from the corner over the outstretched hands of Joel Embiid. You can just have a nice tip-in by OG with 1.4 seconds left.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the potential for player testimony in SEC investigations
quotes.excerpt: There is 100% going to be a desire to establish the pattern and practice taking place.
quotes.quote: There is 100% going to be a desire to establish the pattern and practice taking place, and they're going to want to scrutinize all of these kinds of interactions, which could mean that Kawhi or Gillian or Lance, all of these people, people like Steve Ballmer might be hauled in to testify and share their side of the story.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Boingo Wireless resolved long-standing Wi-Fi issues at Camp Pendleton
quotes.excerpt: they fixed the busted Wi-Fi at Camp Pendleton, which had been a request apparently since 2022

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: I would be remiss if I didn't inform you that Boingo Wireless very conveniently did post a press release itself in late July of this year, 2026, as the NBA's investigators and the Feds and us were all closing in. They fixed the busted Wi-Fi at Camp Pendleton, which had been a request apparently since 2022.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: And I just got to say, we've done a lot on this series, a whole lot since we published part one. But Boingo Wireless finally investing in Wi-Fi at Camp Pendleton, I don't know that that happens if we don't start this whole weird project together.

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: It's of more value than a planted tree, I'll tell you that.
